name: Melious
short: European OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible inference aggregator over 60+ open models from 11+ providers, with pay-as-you-go credits, coding subscriptions, cached-input pricing, and per-request carbon tracking.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go credits
plans.price: Top up credits; no subscription or minimum spend
plans.notes: Per-token list prices across every model, e.g. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash €0.20/€1.00 per 1M (cache €0.01), DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 €0.30/€1.20 (cache €0.03), GLM 5.3 Flash €0.10/€0.40 (cache €0.02); cached input from €0.01/1M.

plans.name: Coding subscriptions
plans.notes: Fixed monthly token allowances for coding agents (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode) on EU-hosted open models: Basic up to 3B tokens/mo (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017; GLM 5.3 up to 700M; GLM 5.3 Flash up to 6.5B), Pro up to 10B (GLM 5.3 up to 2.5B; GLM 5.3 Flash up to 25B). Prices net, plus VAT; offer for businesses (§14 BGB); cancel monthly.

plans.name: Cached input
plans.price: Lower Cache In rate where listed
plans.notes: Repeated prompt prefixes (long system prompts, codebases) are billed at the cached-input price.
